A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same TVC study, with readable main text, equations, Tables 1–5, Figures 1–8, and Appendices A–C. The formatting changes do not prevent reliable comparison.

before.justification: V1 reports original TVC benchmark results, visual-forgetting diagnostics, component ablations, data-scaling experiments, and qualitative examples.

after.justification: V2 retains these original empirical results, including the TVC-7B and TVC-72B evaluations in Table 1 and the accompanying analyses.

M1.justification: DVR training, PVC inference, visual-token pooling, cache resetting, and the distillation/filtering pipeline remain unchanged in Sections 2–3 and Appendix B.

E1.justification: Both use the same four training-data sources in Table 5 and evaluate MathVista, MathVision, MathVerse, Dynamath, and OlympiadBench. The MathVista-Hard diagnostic scenario is also retained.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains identical comparator membership, including both Qwen2-VL sizes and QVQ-72B-preview. The comparison configurations in Tables 2–3 also remain unchanged. Newly cited works are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: The model sizes, training settings, testmini evaluations, excluded benchmark subsets, GPT-4o-mini evaluator, and diagnostic procedures are unchanged. Section 4.1 changes verb tense without revising experimental settings.

E4.justification: Both retain the image-removal and attention analyses, DVR/PVC and pooling ablations, data-scaling experiment, dataset-distribution analysis, and qualitative cases. Figure 7 redisplays the existing distributions rather than introducing another analysis.

E5.justification: Both retain point-estimate reporting without disclosed repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting procedure is added or revised.

E6.justification: Tables 1–3 retain all scores, including the 72B averages of 43.4 for TVC and 40.0 for QVQ. Diagnostic, scaling, distribution, and qualitative findings are unchanged. The abstract's '+3.4 points' clarifies the existing difference previously written '+3.4%'.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(6), including the visual-forgetting relation, reactivation formulation, and distillation expressions, remain mathematically unchanged. No assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added.

C1.justification: The visual-forgetting diagnosis, TVC contribution, and average state-of-the-art claim across five benchmarks remain the same. Correcting the abstract's improvement unit to 'points' does not introduce a different underlying performance claim.

C2.justification: V2 repeats the existing limitations concerning intrinsic reasoning capacity and real-time applicability in Appendix C and links them to the retained Figure 8. These limitations already appear in v1; no new mechanism explanation or applicability boundary is introduced.

D1.justification: Training hyperparameters, hardware, training times, token limits, filtering thresholds, and source-dataset sample counts remain unchanged in Section 4.1, Appendix B, and Tables 4–5. The project access link is equivalent.

R1.justification: Appendix A adds citations to Insight-V, Speculative Ensemble, LMM-R1, PILOT, and MOS without substantially expanding their discussion or redefining TVC's positioning. Parrot's publication update refers to the same previously cited work.

P1.justification: V2 removes 'Revised Paragraph:' from Section 4.3, adjusts training-description tense, clarifies the abstract's improvement unit, updates affiliations, and adds acknowledgments. Existing limitations are repeated in Appendix C; the overall narrative and section order remain stable.

P2.justification: The document is reformatted throughout, changing column geometry, text sizing, author-block layout, running headers, and figure/table placement. Figure 7 replaces tilted plots with decorative reflections with conventional flat charts. The figure and table inventory remains unchanged.

improvement.justification: V2 improves readability through Figure 7's clearer charts, corrects the abstract's improvement unit, and removes an obvious drafting remnant from Section 4.3. These are useful but limited quality gains; the method, empirical support, and reproducibility information remain unchanged.
